title: Timestamp theo timezone shop/report
trigger: Trong Thiết lập cửa hàng, đổi timezone shop-demo từ Asia/Vientiane sang UTC, lưu thành công, rồi điều hướng client-side sang Dòng tiền khi API mock còn giữ trạng thái trong runtime.
browser: Chromium via Playwright; browser timezone was not pinned in this baseline run.

expected.dateOnly: Keep the selected YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; do not convert it as a UTC instant before building the report window.

observed.reason: The shared dateTime helper defaulted to Asia/Vientiane; the range timestamps were therefore rendered at UTC+07 even though the report and shop timezone were UTC.

result: FAIL: UI labels for the UTC report range were 7 hours ahead. Baseline log captures the failing browser assertion and visible DOM text.
harnessNote: The first attempt navigated with a full page reload; the demo MSW runtime resets its in-memory database on reload, so that attempt saw Asia/Vientiane again. It is preserved as S00 and excluded from the product baseline. The accepted S01 run uses client-side SPA navigation and observes the successful UTC shop update.
scopeLimits: Only synthetic frontend API data was used; no backend, provider, or staging behavior is established.
The report's from/to fields are DateTime instants. Date-only fields remain local calendar values and use report boundary helpers.
